messages:
deploy-bot: config-only rollout 'cfg-23120-routing-batch-1' scheduled to prod at 2026-03-20T23:00:00Z. Changes: routing weights, per-request timeout, global batch_size, route-level QPS caps. Stagger plan: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% every 6m. Auto-rollback: pin previous weights if 5xx > 1.5x baseline OR p95 tail > +200ms for 2 consecutive windows.

maria: quick preflight question — what's the new per-route QPS cap and batch defaults?

josh: new defaults: global QPS cap 1500 rps, route default 300 rps, heavy routes 600 rps. batch_size = 32, timeout_ms = 7000. KV cache TTL set to 60s to help hot paths.

maria: dropping the exact config snippet here for visibility:
```json
{
  \"batch_size\": 32,
  \"timeout_ms\": 7000,
  \"routing\": {
    \"default_qps\": 300,
    \"heavy_qps\": 600
  },
  \"burst_window_s\": 30,
  \"slow_start_s\": 120
}
```

rav: can we add a guard for burst_window 30s + slow_start 120s? Also recommend lowering heavy route weight by 5% in the first two steps.

josh: ack, added slow_start 120s and -5% heavy weight on first two steps. Also added a soft-stop that halts ramp if p95 > +150ms for 1 step.

ci-bot: preflight checks: unit tests 124/124 ✅, integration smoke OK ✅, perf baseline comparisons: median latency +1.6% (within tolerance), throughput stable.

sre-ops: will watch SLO dash. Setting alerts: routing_qps_spike, p95_increase, error_rate_5xx. If auto-rollback triggers, we'll pin affected routes to model@v1.12.3 and notify oncall.

maria: :thumbsup: I'm oncall at 23:00, will monitor. Proceed when ready.

deploy-bot: starting rollout -> 2% (step 1)

maria: seeing tiny bump in heavy-route 5xx (+0.6%) — still under rollback threshold. Monitoring.

josh: holding at 2% for one cycle to validate KV-cache effect.

deploy-bot: progressing -> 10% (step 2)

maria: p95 increased by ~120ms on two pods but slow_start still ramping, not steady.

rav: agree continue, but set decision point: if p95 > 200ms at 10% after 6m then rollback.

deploy-bot: progressing -> 50% (step 3)

maria: p95 now back near baseline, error rate normalizing. No rollback.

deploy-bot: rollout completed -> 100% at 2026-03-20T23:18:45Z. No auto-rollback triggered.

sre-ops: created follow-up thread in #incidents/prod-routing to track long-tail perf and to add a canary test for heavy-route under burst.

josh: added a note to the release doc: "post-rollout: watch heavy-route for 48h, consider lowering heavy default qps if repeat bursts".

maria: thanks all — closing this thread. If anything crops up I'll reopen. :white_check_mark:
